notes.title: 9/10 Update Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.  [/p][p][/p][p]Our September 10 update introduces new limited-time events, along with a series of fixes for known issues and overall gameplay improvements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]1️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]2️⃣ \[New Events][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]3️⃣ \[Shop][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]4️⃣ \[Bug Fixes][/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][h3][b] [/b][/h3][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Certain exchangeable byproducts from Ferocious Beasts, previously obtainable only in base difficulty, can now also be acquired when a World Level is applied.[/p][p]🔸 The amount of Copper obtained from certain chests in Enemy Hideouts when a World Level is applied has been increased.[/p][p]🔸 The instant progression feature for the Season 2 Pass is now available.[/p][p]     ✔️ Players can use Golden Dragons to instantly advance by the desired number of levels.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY [/b][/h3][p]🔸 A cooldown has been added to the Taunt skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Angry Bull.[/p][p]🔸 A cooldown has been added to the Dodge skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Direwolf.[/p][p]🔸 The frequency of the Charge skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Direwolf has been reduced.[/p][h3] [/h3][h3][b]⚜️ INVENTORY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The number of default slots for Basic and Equipment inventory has been increased.[/p][p]     ✔️ Basic Inventory: 25 slots → 35 slots[/p][p]     ✔️ Equipment Inventory: 40 slots → 50 slots[/p][p]🔸 The purchase limit for Inventory Expansion Tools in the Regional Currency Exchange Shops has been increased.[/p][p]🔸 An Inventory Expansion Tool has been added to the Alliance Shop, available from Alliance Level 2 and above.[/p][p]🔸 New Basic/Equipment Inventory Expansion Tools purchasable with Golden Dragons have been added to the Support/Convenience tab within the shop. [/p][p]🔸 The maximum number of inventory slots that can be expanded using Expansion Tools has been increased.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p]👉 [b]Missions Await: Claim Your Rewards in Westeros[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸 New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p]🔸 Certain items will no longer be available for purchase after September 24th. Please see below for more details.[/p][p]     ✔️ Wormwalks Challenge Conquest Package[/p][p]▸ Any unclaimed or unearned rewards will be automatically delivered to the mailbox.[/p][p]     ✔️ Westeros Welcome Package (Trial included)[/p][p]     ✔️ Mail Crow (Trial included)[/p][p]▸ Players who purchased either the Westeros Welcome Package or Mail Crow will be refunded in Iron Bank Marks.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the selling price of Tier 6 equipment was set the same as Tier 4 equipment.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed the spinning animation of the Giant Spider boss in Beyond the Wall Expeditions.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where characters could become stuck in certain terrain within the Oldtown Enemy Hideout - Shaded Septry.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Black Elk’s daze gauge was incorrectly applied in World Levels. [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Implemented various UI/UX improvements.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!  [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 8/28 Update Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Our latest update introduces the [b]World Level System [/b]along with a new equipment tier, dungeon challenges, and a range of improvements designed to enhance your journey through Westeros.

Adjust the difficulty of the world, tackle the formidable Giant Ice Spider in the Altar of Memories, and craft powerful Tier 6 gear to strengthen your forces. Alongside these additions, we’ve made various gameplay improvements and fixes to enhance your overall experience.

Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ \[New Content][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣\[New Events] [/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣\[Shop][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/u][/b][/p][p align="center"][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]
🌎 NEW CONTENT
[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🗺️ World Level System [/b][/h3][p]🔹 The new World Level System has been added to allow players to adjust the difficulty of the game to better match their power and progression. [/p][p]🔹 You can access the World Level system via the button at the top of the [b]☰ Menu[/b]. Field content difficulty will automatically scale based on your selected level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/3791465da8da3b4ebc25125ad00b61e63ba7b69c.png"][/img][/p][p]▸ World Level 1 & 2 have been added in this update.[/p][p][b]⚠️ Please note: A cooldown applies after changing the World Level.
[/b][/p][p][b]🔹 How To Unlock:[/b][/p][p]     ✔️ World Level 1: Complete the main quest [b]“Snow and Storm”[/b] from [b]Episode XIV - The Crow’s Bastard[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ World Level 2: Reach 150,000 Momentum

🔹 Repeatable content rewards now scale with the selected World Level. (One-time and first-time completion rewards remain unchanged.)[/p][p]🔹 At World Level 1,[b] Tier 6 Epic-grade[/b] materials and equipment become obtainable, while at World Level 2 and higher, [b]Tier 6 Legendary-grade[/b] materials and equipment can be acquired.[/p][p]🔹 New achievements related to World Levels have been added.[/p][p]🔹 Setting World Level 1 or higher allows all Ferocious Beast Maesters to exchange Beast Pelt Scraps.[/p][h3]
[b]⚔️ New Equipment Tier[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Tier 6 equipment has been added.[/p][p]🔹 Tier 6 gear can be crafted once you reach Forge Level 8 and Character Level 37 (Estate Level 25 required).[/p][p]🔹 The following tabs have been updated to include Tier 6: Set Research, Set Collection, Craft Equipment, and Reforge Equipment. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🕸 Altar of Memories: Giant Ice Spider Hard Mode[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Get ready to face a new challenge! A new Hard difficulty has been added to the Altar of Memories: face off against the Frostbite Giant Ice Spider. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b]
[/h3][p][b]🔸 Artifact Expeditions: [/b]Rewards have been streamlined. Junk loot has been removed, and completing an expedition now grants Copper directly, without the need to sell items separately.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Altar of Memories Rankings Rewards: [/b]With the introduction of the new Hard difficulty in the Altar of Memories, ranking rewards have been adjusted:[/p][p]    ✔️ The rewards previously tied to the former top difficulty, Stormshower Plains – Stormhorn Unicorn, have been shifted to the new top-tier challenge, Frostbite - Giant Ice Spider.[/p][p]    ✔️ This adjustment applies to all non-equipment rewards. Tiered equipment rewards remain specific to each dungeon.[/p][p]    ✔️ Lower-difficulty dungeons have also been adjusted, with their rewards moved up one tier to match the next-highest difficulty.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p align="center"][b]Altar of Memories[/b][/p][/th][th][p align="center"][b]Ranking Rewards[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Shores of Dorne - Blue Cockatrice[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Removed[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Frozen Cave - Giant Ice Spider[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Removed[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Valley of Gold - Ironbeak Griffin[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Shores of Dorne - Cockatrices[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Stormshower Plains - Stormhorn Unicorn[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Frostbite - Giant Ice Spider[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]New[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]🍰 [/b]A new time-limited buff item [b]100 Days Celebration Cake[/b] has been added, which applies the following effects for 30 minutes upon use:[/p][p]🔹 Attack Power +10%[/p][p]🔹 Critical Strike Damage +10%[/p][p]🔹 Rage Consumption -15%[/p][p]▸ This item can be obtained through events held in celebration of the 100-day milestone.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸 The difficulty of certain Guidebook missions, including Side Quests, the Altar of Memories, and selected Field Content, has been reduced to ensure a smoother progression experience.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/536611691635409323?snr=2___"]👉 100 Days of Kingsroad: Special Events[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.
[/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where characters could occasionally fall off cliffs in certain Beyond the Wall Expedition stages.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in Altar of Lost Memories - Kraken where ink projectiles disappeared before hitting the ground.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where World Boss Black Shadow Drogon could sometimes freeze during combat. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where World Boss Black Shadow Drogon could become immune to damage for a period of time under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where some effects of the Assassin’s Strike Combo IV Mastery: Elimination did not trigger correctly. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the damage of the Assassin’s Dagger Throw skill did not increase properly when leveled up. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the defeating the Elite Solder in the Enemy Hideout “Woods Fortress” did not count towards the mission under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue that prevented the completion of the Enemy Hideout “Raven’s Rock Fortress” under certain conditions. 
[/p][h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Added additional unskippable dialogue lines in cutscenes for the seasonal side quests “The Crown of Love and Death” and “Prisoner of the Iron Islands.”[/p][p]🔸 Fixed unnatural NPC movements during the tournament sequence in the seasonal side quest “The Crown of Love and Death.”[/p][p]🔸 Fixed collision issues when using the Follow Path feature.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where certain enemies in the North’s Enemy Hideout “Coastal Fortress” could move outside the intended area. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ CONTROL & INPUT [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Added fences and adjusted terrain on select bridges in Brightwater Keep to prevent frequent falls.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Implemented various UI/UX improvements.[/p][p]🔸 Updated certain quest dialogue for clarity.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where wild animals could occasionally spawn beneath the terrain.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!  [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img]
[/p]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, we’d like to give our players a [b]sneak peek at the upcoming content[/b] that will be added during Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival.[/p][p] [/p][p]Check out the details below to get a glimpse of what’s in store. From fresh challenges to engaging new adventures, there’s plenty to look forward to, and we hope you’re as excited as we are to experience everything Season 2 has to offer![/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🌍 World Level System[/b][/h3][h3] [/h3][p]To provide players with greater challenges and a stronger sense of accomplishment, we are introducing the [b]World Level System[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]This system is designed to[b] elevate the difficulty and rewards[/b] of repeatable content across the entire open world, bringing a new sense of excitement and tension into environments you’ve already grown familiar with.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the World Level System, all repeatable content in the open world will scale according to the selected level. The world will automatically adjust to match this level, ensuring that every encounter reflects the challenge you’ve chosen.[/p][p][i]🚨 Please note that rewards from one-time rewards will not scale.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Players will unlock the World Level system after completing the final quest currently available in the main story (Stormlands - Crow’s Nest) and certain stages of the Wormwalks Challenge. When entering a World Level, both content difficulty and rewards will scale accordingly.[/p][p] [/p][p]This update will introduce World Levels 1 and 2, offering tougher enemies and a higher level of challenge for players ready to test their skills.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🏰 Altar of Memories – Hard Difficulty[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]With the introduction of the World Level System, a new Hard Difficulty is coming to the Altar of Memories.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first boss players will face on Hard Difficulty is the Giant Ice Spider. Its appearance is far more menacing, and it now wields stronger, more unpredictable skills that push players beyond the challenges of the normal version.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeating the Giant Ice Spider on Hard Difficulty will reward[b] new tier equipment[/b], giving you every reason to prepare for these intense and strategic battles. Sharpen your skills and get ready to face a tougher, more formidable foe than before.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🛡️ Tier 6 Equipment[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Higher-tier rewards will also be available as another part of the new World Level System.[/p][p] [/p][p]At World Level 1, players will be able to obtain materials for Tier 6 equipment. These materials are not limited to specific Ferocious Beasts. [b]All Ferocious Beasts at this level will drop Tier 6 crafting materials[/b], and you will be able to challenge any beast at this level to collect them.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Tier 6 equipment will be craftable once your character reaches level 37 and your Estate reaches level 25, which allows you to upgrade your Forge to level 8.[/b] All Ferocious Beast byproducts will be exchangeable while in World Level 1 and above.[/p][p] [/p][p]Players will be able to use World Level content to collect these materials and craft the new Tier 6 equipment, preparing themselves for even more challenging adventures ahead.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]This update is only the beginning for World Level content.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are already preparing even more diverse World Level experiences for future seasons, and detailed information will be shared in an upcoming Developer Note later this month.[/p][p] [/p][p]We hope you’ll stay excited as we continue expanding World Level content and introducing new additions to enhance your adventures.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for being part of our growing world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]	[/p]

tags.feature: To provide players with greater challenges and a stronger sense of accomplishment, we are introducing the [b]World Level System[/b].

This system is designed to[b] elevate the difficulty and rewards[/b] of repeatable content across the entire open world, bringing a new sense of excitement and tension into environments you’ve already grown familiar with.

With the World Level System, all repeatable content in the open world will scale according to the selected level. The world will automatically adjust to match this level, ensuring that every encounter reflects the challenge you’ve chosen.
This update will introduce World Levels 1 and 2, offering tougher enemies and a higher level of challenge for players ready to test their skills.
With the introduction of the World Level System, a new Hard Difficulty is coming to the Altar of Memories.

The first boss players will face on Hard Difficulty is the Giant Ice Spider. Its appearance is far more menacing, and it now wields stronger, more unpredictable skills that push players beyond the challenges of the normal version.

Defeating the Giant Ice Spider on Hard Difficulty will reward[b] new tier equipment[/b], giving you every reason to prepare for these intense and strategic battles. Sharpen your skills and get ready to face a tougher, more formidable foe than before.
Higher-tier rewards will also be available as another part of the new World Level System.

At World Level 1, players will be able to obtain materials for Tier 6 equipment. These materials are not limited to specific Ferocious Beasts. [b]All Ferocious Beasts at this level will drop Tier 6 crafting materials[/b], and you will be able to challenge any beast at this level to collect them.

[b]Tier 6 equipment will be craftable once your character reaches level 37 and your Estate reaches level 25, which allows you to upgrade your Forge to level 8.[/b] All Ferocious Beast byproducts will be exchangeable while in World Level 1 and above.
Players will be able to use World Level content to collect these materials and craft the new Tier 6 equipment, preparing themselves for even more challenging adventures ahead.

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p][/p][p]A server patch is scheduled to address several issues identified in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Please see below for more details.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]☑️ Patch Schedule[/b][/h3][p]🔹August 12, 07:00 PM - 07:10 PM (PT)[/p][p]▸ The patch schedule is subject to change.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]☑️ Patch Details[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Fix an issue where the Knight skill “Boost Morale (Enhanced)” did not immediately grant Fighting Spirit when used.[/p][p]🔹 Fix an issue where certain Artifact skills were unintentionally affecting Season Effects. [/p][p]🔹 Fix an issue where the Daily Mission “Log in Daily” in the Guidebook could not be completed.[/p][p]🔹 Fix an issue where the Guidebook Chapter 7-3 mission “Unlock Beyond the Wall Expedition Manager Base” could not be completed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]📌 Additional Notes[/b][/h3][p]🔸Due to potential changes in quest progress and other game content, we strongly recommend logging out of the game from a safe area before the patch is applied.[/p][p]🔸Please refrain from using daily content and buff items until after the patch has been completed, as game connection may be unstable. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We will continue to do our utmost to provide you with an enjoyable experience in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]	[/p]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]A data patch is scheduled to address known issues within the game.[/p][p] [/p][p]Please see below for more details.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]☑️ Patch Schedule[/b][/p][p]🔹After August 7, 10:40 PM (PT)[/p][p]▸ The patch schedule is subject to change.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]☑️ Patch Devices[/b][/p][p]🔹 PC[/p][p]🔹 Mobile (iOS)[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]☑️ Patch Details[/b][/p][p]🔹Fixed an issue where the game could crash in the PC environment.[/p][p]🔹Fixed an issue where the side quest The Citadel’s Lost Giant cannot be progressed during the “Follow Ameline” step on iOS devices.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]📌 Additional Notes[/b][/p][p]🔸 A game restart is required to download the patch data.[/p][p]🔸 As the patch may involve a large amount of data, we recommend using a stable Wi-Fi connection when downloading.[/p][p]🔸 You may continue to access and play the game without downloading the patch.[/p][p]▸ However, we strongly recommend downloading the patch to ensure a more stable gameplay experience.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We will continue to do our utmost to provide you with an enjoyable experience in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p] [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 8/7 Update Notes [Updated on 8/7 02:45 PT]
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our latest update ushers in [b]Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b], bringing fresh adventures and exciting new content to Westeros.[/p][p]
Join the celebration with brand-new seasonal quests, bounties, and a brand-new Season Pass featuring exclusive rewards, including the coveted Laurels of Victory weapon skin.[/p][p][/p][p]Season 2 also expands Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks with unique seasonal mechanics, while improvements to skills, artifacts, and gameplay balance ensure a more thrilling experience for all players.
[/p][p]Additionally, we’ve included a variety of system enhancements and bug fixes to smooth your journey through the realm.
[/p][p]Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ \[New Content][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣\[New Events] [/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣\[Shop][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/u][/b][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🍷 NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🌸 Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b][/h3][p]♦️ Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival officially begins. [/p][p]     ✔️ The new seasonal content is available after completing the main quest [b]“Report to Lord Roose Bolton”[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ The new seasonal quests and bounties are available after completing the main quest [b]“Talk to Maester Seymour”[/b] in Highgarden. [/p][p]♦️ A brand new Season Pass is now available. [/p][p]♦️ Clearing seasonal content will allow you to progress Season Pass missions, and increase your pass level, unlocking exclusive seasonal progression elements along the way. [/p][p]♦️ Reach the final tier of the Season Pass to unlock the new exclusive [b]Laurels of Victory Weapon Skin[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ The  weapon skin can be equipped via Equipment ➜ Wardrobe. [/p][p]     ✔️ After reaching the final Season Pass tier, additional versions of the weapon skin for other classes can be purchased from the shop. [/p][p]♦️ Two new side quests (The Citadel’s Lost Giant & The Crown of Love and Death) and bounties themed around “Highgarden Grand Festival” are available. [/p][p]♦️ The quest “The Crown of Love and Death” will become available after completing “The Citadel’s Lost Giant”. [/p][p]♦️ Beyond the Wall Expeditions and seasonal Wormwalks have been updated for Season 2. [/p][p][/p][p]📢 The world level system, previously announced in the most recent developer note, will be added in an update in the near future along with tier 6 equipment and a Hard difficulty for Altar of Memories - Giant Ice Spider. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌹 Seasonal Content & Exclusive Effects \[Updated on 8/7 02:45 PT][/b][/h3][p]♦️ The seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks feature exclusive seasonal mechanics. [/p][p]♦️ Participating in these seasonal activities does not consume RP, but instead uses a separate pool of reward attempts. [/p][p]♦️ When progressing through Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks, the season-exclusive effect [b]Trial of Fervor[/b] will be active, along with the Fervor Gauge. [/p][p]▸ These seasonal effects or traits do not apply to the original Wormwalks stages. [/p][p][b]     ✔️ Trial Gauge: [/b]The Trial Gauge gradually fills whenever certain conditions are met. Once the gauge reaches certain thresholds, you will suffer significant damage and harmful effects. The conditions for charging the Trial Gauge differ between Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks. 
[b]     ✔️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition: [/b]Fervor gradually builds up when taking damage from enemies. 
[b]     ✔️ Seasonal Wormwalks: [/b]Fervor gradually builds up over time during combat or when taking damage. [/p][p]▸ Gaining a barrier instantly removes all active Trial of Fervor debuffs. While the barrier is active, you are immune to the harmful effects of the Trial Gauge.[/p][p]♦️ Season Growth Points earned from the Season Pass can be used to enhance traits specific to Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]♦️ Rankings have been added for Season 2 of Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks. [/p][p]     ✔️ Each set of rankings includes a weekly ranking, calculated and rewarded every week, and a final ranking, determined based on performance across the entire season.
[/p][p][b]📢 Clear rewards will be provided based on the number of Beyond the Wall Expedition tickets owned prior to the maintenance on August 6th. [/b]
[/p][h3][b]🏺New Artifacts[/b][/h3][p]🔹3 new Artifacts have been added.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Grade[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Name[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Type[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]Bronze Harpy Statue[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][td][p]Laughing Tree’s Tattered Cloth[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]Crown of Winter Roses[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]➕ [b]Content Expansion[/b][/h3][p]♦️ Wormwalks Challenge has been expanded from stage 50 ➜ 55. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][h3][b]
⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 A leaderboard for Wormwalks Challenge has been added. [/p][p]▸ Please note that these rankings do not have rewards. [/p][p]🔸 You can now use any jewelry of the same grade and slot as material when recasting, rather than being limited to identical pieces.[/p][p]     ✔️ You can still use identical jewelry when recasting, which reduces the number of materials needed compared to using other different pieces.[/p][p]🔸 The maximum recast level for legendary jewelry has been increased from 5 ➜ 7. [/p][p]🔸 Added support for DualSense and other controllers on mobile devices. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ SKILLS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Certain skills have been grouped together. [/p][p]🔸 When you level up one skill in a group, all skills within that group will level up simultaneously. [/p][p]     ✔️ The skill point cost for leveling up a grouped skill remains the same as before, with no additional points spent. [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Before[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]After[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Strike Combo I[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo II[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo III[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo IV[/p][/td][td][p]Strike Combo[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Evasion Attack [/p][p]✔ Sprint Attack (Light)
✔ Sprint Attack (Heavy)[/p][/td][td][p]Moving Attack[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Sneak Attack [/p][p]✔ Mighty Strike[/p][p]✔ Parry-linked Attack[/p][/td][td][p]Special Attack[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]📢 [b]Please note that as a result of the skill grouping changes, all skill and mastery levels will be reset upon your first login after the update. Please be sure to re-allocate your skill and mastery points. [/b][/p][p]🔸 The naming convention for + Skill Effects obtained through refinement has been changed. [/p][p]    ✔️ For example: Merciless Strike + ➜ Merciless Strike (Enhanced)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🗡️ KNIGHT[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first two hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The skill effect and cooldown for Boost Morale & Boost Morale (Enhanced) have been adjusted. [/p][p]    ✔️ Damage Taken Reduction: 25 - 37.5% ➜ Active Skill Damage Increase: 20%[/p][p]    ✔️ Cooldown: 30 seconds ➜ 24 seconds[/p][p][/p][p][b]🪓 SELLSWORD[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first two hits from Strike Combo III has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The cooldown and effect duration of the Roar & Roar (Enhanced) skill have been adjusted. [/p][p]    ✔️ Cooldown: 30 seconds ➜ 24 seconds[/p][p]    ✔️ Damage Increase effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]    ✔️ Berserk Reforge Effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]    ✔️ Vitality Reforge Effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]🔸 The duration of the Rampage skill has been increased to 12 seconds. [/p][p]🔸 The duration of the Defense Decrease effect on enemies from Rampage (Enhanced) has been increased (10 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]ASSASSIN[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo III has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The Bloodburst effect stacks are no longer shared with other characters. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ OTHER[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The maximum number of normal enemies that can be stunned by Legendary Artifacts has been increased (4 ➜ 10).[/p][p]🔸 The buff radius for Active Artifact Skills that can affect party members has been significantly increased. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🤝 ALLIANCE[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Alliance missions have been revamped. [/p][p]    ✔️ Alliance Mission Chance Recharge Ticket items have been removed. In exchange, Alliance Coins will be granted based on your Alliance Level as shown below.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Alliance Level[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Distributed Alliance Coins[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1-4[/p][/td][td][p]0[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]5-9[/p][/td][td][p]750[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]10-14[/p][/td][td][p]1,500[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]15-19[/p][/td][td][p]3,000[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]20+[/p][/td][td][p]5,200[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]🔸 Personal Missions are now divided into daily and weekly missions. [/p][p]    ✔️ Daily missions can be completed once per day, while weekly missions can be completed once per week. [/p][p]🔸 The alliance check-in missions have been removed from Guidebook > Daily Missions. [/p][p]🔸 Guidebook > Weekly missions have been adjusted, with improved rewards for the final stage. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]❄️ SEASON 1 CHANGES[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Season 1 bounties will remain accessible even after the end of season 1. [/p][p][b]   ✔️ Winterfell Bounties: [/b]Smudge & Black Manta[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Prerequisites: [/b]You must have completed the Winterfell Main Quest “The North Remembers” and side quest “Order of Wolves”. [/p][p]🔸 Season 1 field monsters have been removed, and the item “\[Season] Ironborn's Loot” will no longer drop. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]
🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955804"]👉 \[Highgarden Grand Festival: Season 2 Events][/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955804"]👉 \[August Events: Trials, Missions, and More][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p]🔸A new Battle Pass and Season Pass have been added. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955798"]👉 \[Battle Pass: Blackfish in the Moonlight][/url][/p][p]    🗓️ Available until the September 24 maintenance[/p][p]    ⚠️ The Premium and Premium+ versions of the Battle Pass can be purchased [b]until September 23, 10:59 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955800"]👉 \[Season Pass: Highgarden Grand Festival][/url][/p][p]    🗓️ Available until the September 24 maintenance[/p][p]    ⚠️ The Premium version of the Season Pass can be purchased [b]until September 23, 10:59 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the weekly contribution of offline Alliance members would not update after a reset. [/p][p]🔸 Cooldowns for Artifact Skills and Active Skills will now be shared when moving between the single world and multi-space areas. [/p][p]🔸 Cooldowns for Artifact Skills and Active Skills will now reset upon entering a dungeon.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 You can now move while using draughts. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the “Ferocious Beast Codex clue acquired” message would be incorrectly displayed upon defeating a Ferocious Beast for a subsequent time. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the horn break gauge for the Ferocious Beast: Angry Bull would occasionally not increase properly. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the QTE buttons would occasionally not appear during certain Ferocious Beast encounters. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the purchase limit was displayed incorrectly for some account-limited items in the Shadowcat Parts Exchange Shop. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Sneak Attack button could reappear during an ongoing Sneak Attack, causing an error message to be displayed.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where NPCs could appear duplicated after clearing a Bandit Camp under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the name and difficulty of the current “Beyond the Wall Expeditions” stage were displayed incorrectly on the results screen after a failed attempt. [/p][p]🔸 Adjusted certain text to better clarify the activation conditions of certain random Amulet effects.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Amulet option “deals more damage when attacking enemies with less than 50% HP” was being applied incorrectly under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where stat increases from Amulet effects were not displaying correctly on jewelry.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where players could skip the intro cutscene in Altar of Memories: Stormhorn Unicorn, and attack before combat began. [/p][p]    ✔️ As a result, players will no longer be able to move into the combat area until the battle officially starts.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where being knocked outside the combat zone during certain content prevented players from progressing.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the second attack of Merciless Strike (Enhanced) skill would occasionally fail to trigger.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Onslaught Draught was not consumed properly in certain situations.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the effect of the Agile Movement skill was occasionally not properly removed after use..[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where certain pathfinding indicators were not displaying correctly during the main quest “The Bastard and the Sellsword”. [/p][p]🔸 The location of certain Lost Letters in the White Harbor area have been adjusted. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ WORLD [/b][/h3][p]🔸 The location of the Cliffside signpost has been adjusted. [/p][p]🔸 A new Rosewater Bridge signpost has been added in the Highgarden region. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Various UI/UX improvements have been made. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the progress for some Legacy Reclaimed Artifact achievements was not displayed properly. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where some terrain objects appeared to be floating.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where hotkeys would not work properly when selecting rewards after clearing content. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community![/p][p]

🔸 Adjusted certain text to better clarify the activation conditions of certain random Amulet effects.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the Amulet option “deals more damage when attacking enemies with less than 50% HP” was being applied incorrectly under certain conditions.
🔸Fixed an issue where stat increases from Amulet effects were not displaying correctly on jewelry.
🔸 Fixed an issue where players could skip the intro cutscene in Altar of Memories: Stormhorn Unicorn, and attack before combat began.
🔸 Fixed an issue where being knocked outside the combat zone during certain content prevented players from progressing.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the second attack of Merciless Strike (Enhanced) skill would occasionally fail to trigger.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the Onslaught Draught was not consumed properly in certain situations.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the effect of the Agile Movement skill was occasionally not properly removed after use..
🔸 Fixed an issue where certain pathfinding indicators were not displaying correctly during the main quest “The Bastard and the Sellsword”.
🔸 The location of certain Lost Letters in the White Harbor area have been adjusted.
🔸 The location of the Cliffside signpost has been adjusted.
🔸 A new Rosewater Bridge signpost has been added in the Highgarden region.
🔸 Various UI/UX improvements have been made.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the progress for some Legacy Reclaimed Artifact achievements was not displayed properly.
🔸 Fixed an issue where some terrain objects appeared to be floating.
🔸 Fixed an issue where hotkeys would not work properly when selecting rewards after clearing content.

notes.title: 6/26 Update Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our June 26 update brings the first major content drop since launch, and with it, the arrival of [b]Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]This new season introduces the Kraken Raid, where a powerful new enemy and valuable rewards await. The newly added Amulet system also brings fresh ways to enhance your strength and customize your build.[/p][p]  [/p][p]A new difficulty level for World Boss Drogon has also been added, offering a greater challenge for seasoned players alongside a host of new content. This update also brings limited-time seasonal events, a range of system improvements, and a round of bug fixes for known issues.[/p][p] [/p][p]Check out the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ New Content[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ Improvements & Changes[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣New Events[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣Shop[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣Bug Fixes[/u][/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛡️ NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚔️ Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b][/h3][p]🔹Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes officially begins.[/p][p]▸ The new season is available after completing the main quest [b]Report to Lord Roose Bolton[/b].[/p][p]🔹Clearing seasonal content will advance Season Pass missions. As the pass level increases, you can unlock exclusive seasonal progression elements along the way.[/p][p]🔹A brand-new season pass is now available.[/p][p]🔹Reach the final tier of the season pass to unlock the exclusive [b]Krakencoil Weapon Skin[/b].[/p][p]     ✔️ The weapon skin can be equipped through [b]Equipment ➜ Wardrobe[/b].[/p][p]     ✔️ After reaching the final season pass tier, additional versions of the Krakencoil weapon skin for other classes can be purchased from the shop.[/p][p]🔹New side quests and bounties themed around “The Drowned God Wakes” are available.[/p][p]     ✔️ These side quests and bounties will remain accessible even after the season ends.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions[/b][/h3][p]🔹The previous Beyond the Wall Expedition has been revamped into the seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition.[/p][p]    ✔️ Ranking rewards for the original Beyond the Wall Expeditions will be calculated based on standings just before the Season 1 update, and will be distributed sequentially starting July 1st (PT).[/p][p]🔹Several of the original Beyond the Wall Expedition effects have been adjusted or removed, and the related shop items have been reworked.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Wormwalks[/b][/h3][p]🔹A seasonal version of Wormwalks has been added, available alongside the original Wormwalks content.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Content & Effects[/b][/h3][p]🔹The seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks feature exclusive seasonal mechanics.[/p][p]🔹Participating in these seasonal activities does not consume RP, but instead uses a separate pool of reward attempts.[/p][p]🔹When progressing through Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks, the season-exclusive effect [b]Trial of Steel[/b] will be active, along with two new gauges: [b]Heat [/b]and [b]Erosion[/b].[/p][p]▸ These seasonal effects or traits do not apply to the original Wormwalks stages.[/p][p]     ✔️ [b]Heat Gauge: [/b]Builds up upon landing Active Skills on enemies, granting buffs that aid combat based on its accumulation.[/p][p]     ✔️ [b]Erosion Gauge: [/b]Builds up upon landing Strike Combos on enemies or when damage is taken, applying debuffs that hinder combat effectiveness as it accumulates.[/p][p]🔹Beyond the Wall Expedition Season Growth Points & Wormwalks Season Growth Points earned through the Season Pass can be used to enhance traits related to Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]🔹New rankings have been added for Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]     ✔️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition Rankings and Seasonal Wormwalks Rankings consist of interim rankings, which are counted and settled every two weeks. Final rankings are counted and settled over the entire season period (6 weeks).[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]🗺️ New Region: Crow’s Nest[/b][/h3][p]🔹The new region [b]Crow’s Nest[/b] is now available.[/p][p]🔹New main quests, as well as side quests and encounter quests have been added.[/p][p]🔹The side quest “Silent Lighthouse” is available after completing the prerequisite quest “Red Book” and clearing the Occupied Site “Griffin’s Cove”.[/p][p]     ✔️ Although the “Silent Lighthouse” quest is a direct continuation of “Red Book”, it begins with a character located inside of Griffin’s Cove, so the Occupied Zone must be cleared before it becomes accessible.[/p][p]🔹Additional regional content is now available, including:[/p][p]     ✔️ Bounties[/p][p]     ✔️ Ferocious Beast[/p][p]     ✔️ Echoes of the Past[/p][p]     ✔️ Enemy Hideout[/p][p]     ✔️ Gods’ Havens[/p][p]     ✔️ Historic Sites[/p][p]     ✔️ Occupied Sites[/p][p]     ✔️ Bandit Camps[/p][p]🔹Exploration Progress rewards for stages 3 and 4 have been added to the Stormlands region.[/p][p]🔹New items have been added to the Tribute Exchange Shop, and the exchange limits for certain items have been increased.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]🏺New Artifacts[/b][/h3][p]🔹3 new Artifacts have been added.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Grade[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Name[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Type[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]Black Driftwood[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][td][p]Marksman's Quiver[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]The Broken Sword[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]🦑 Kraken Raid[/b][/h3][p]🔹The new co-op content [b]Kraken Raid [/b]has been added.[/p][p]🔹Access the dungeon through the [b]Weirwood located within Storm’s End[/b], in the Stormlands.[/p][p]🔹Designed for 4-player parties, raid rewards can be earned based on the number of dungeon completions (2 charges per week, with a maximum accumulation of 4).[/p][p]🔹Defeating the Kraken grants a chance to obtain [b]Amulet Core [/b]crafting materials.[/p][p]🔹A new leaderboard for Kraken Raid rankings has been added.[/p][p]🔹New achievements related to the Kraken Raid have been added. [b]

[/b][/p][h3]💎 [b]Amulet System[/b][/h3][p]🔹Visit the [b]Amulet Workshop [/b](accessible via Raven Messenger > Amulet Workshop or the actual Amulet Workshop in Renan’s Rest) to craft and polish Amulets.[/p][p] 🔹A total of 9 Amulets have been added (3 Rare, 3 Epic, and 3 Legendary).[/p][p]🔹All Amulets provide fixed effects, along with additional random effects based on their rarity.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="183,291"][tr][th colwidth="183"][p][b]Amulet[/b][/p][/th][th colwidth="291"][p][b]Fixed Effects[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="183"][p]Kraken’s Heart Amulet[/p][/td][td colwidth="291"][p]✔ Ranged Attack Damage Increase[/p][p]✔ HP[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="183"][p]Kraken’s Wrath Amulet[/p][/td][td colwidth="291"][p]✔ Active Skill Damage Increase[/p][p]✔ HP[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="183"][p]Kraken’s Grasp Amulet[/p][/td][td colwidth="291"][p]✔ Strike Combo Damage Increase[/p][p]✔ HP[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][h3]➕ [b]Content Expansion[/b][/h3][p]🔹Wormwalks has been expanded from stage 40 to 50.[/p][p]🔹A new difficulty tier for World Boss Drogon is now available. This version of Drogon can be accessed from the [b]Scorched Plain [/b]in the Stormlands region.[/p][p] [/p][h3]➕ [b]Additional New Content[/b][/h3][p]🔹New emojis and emotes have been added.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸The maximum character level has been increased to [b]level 50[/b].[/p][p]🔸Set Research levels have been expanded to [b]level 50[/b].[/p][p]🔸Two new Equipment Sets and Set Effects have been added: [b]Guardian [/b]and [b]Tempest[/b].[/p][p]🔸Level requirements for crafting Tier 3 to 5 equipment have been eased.[/p][p]🔸Using Ruin Runners or Relic Finders for Artifact Expeditions no longer consumes worker stamina.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️COMBAT[/b][/h3][p]🔸The Momentum penalty for fighting enemies with higher Momentum has been removed.[/p][p]    ✔️ Visual effects indicating low Momentum will still appear, even though the penalty no longer applies.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️CHANGES TO CONTENT REWARD ACQUISITION[/b][/h3][p]🔸Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Altar of Memories will no longer require RP to obtain rewards. Instead, rewards are now granted by using up the available reward attempts for each activity.[/p][p][b]    ✔️ Beyond the Wall Expedition: [/b]Entry will be restricted once all reward attempts have been used.[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Altar of Memories & Kraken Raid: [/b]Entry remains possible even after reward attempts are exhausted, but no rewards can be earned.[/p][p]🔸With this new reward system, reward counts will be automatically consumed and rewards will be granted upon clearing the content. As a result, the unclaimed dungeon reward system will no longer apply.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/591771368562885852?snr=2___"][b]👉 Ongoing Events in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b][/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p]🔸A new Battle Pass and Season Pass have been added.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536605983645892926"]👉 Battle Pass: Echoes of the Storm and the Wolf[/url][/b][/p][p]    🗓️ Available until  August 6, 10:59 PM (PT)[/p][p]    ⚠️ The Premium and Premium+ versions of the Battle Pass can be purchased [b]until July 23, 10:59 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536605983645892909"]👉 Season Pass: The Drowned God Wakes[/url][/b][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][h2]
[b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where patch resources were repeatedly downloaded on each login.[/p][p]🔸The rules for creating new channels have been updated:[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Before:[/b] New channels were created only when all existing channels reached full capacity.[/p][p][b]   ✔️ After:[/b] New channels will now be created once all existing channels reach 80% capacity.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️SHOP[/b][/h3][p]🔸Fixed a bug where incorrect text would be displayed when selecting certain shop items.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️GAMEPLAY & COMBAT[/b][/h3][p]🔸Recommended levels for side quests in Storm’s End and Felwood regions have been adjusted based on the starting level of each chapter.[/p][p]🔸Interaction times for gadgets in repeatable RP-consuming content have been reduced for smoother gameplay.[/p][p]🔸Adjusted terrain in the Historic Site in Oldtown to allow for smoother movement via jumping.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain interactable objects in Historic Ruins could not be activated.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in Altar of Memories - Shores of Dorne Blue Cockatrices where the second Cockatrice would not appear if the first was defeated too quickly.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the recommended momentum for Echoes of the Past in the Stormlands were displayed incorrectly.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the level 3 description for certain effects in Beyond the Wall Expedition displayed a value of 0%.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in [b]Explore cliff paths[/b] in Beyond the Wall Expedition where the tree could not be cut down, preventing progress.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the rewards pop-up would occasionally not display immediately after defeating a Ferocious Beast.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where using bait would sometimes fail to spawn a Ferocious Beast.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where dying to the Ferocious Beast Black Elk could sometimes cause players to spawn in the Stormlands.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the Wormwalks rewards displayed on the results screen did not match the actual rewards received.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the Bandit Camp in the Gift region could not be completed under certain conditions.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Wormwalks rewards could not be acquired under certain conditions.[/p][p]    ✔️ The rewards that could not be acquired previously due to the above issue will be distributed sequentially after the update.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain class-specific equipment could be used by other classes.[/p][p]🔸The respawn rate of equipment chests in certain areas has been adjusted.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain treasures chests in Bandit Camps could not be opened. [/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Ambition was occasionally consumed during Beyond the Wall Expedition. [/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain field content could not be cleared under certain conditions.  [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸A prologue skip feature has been added.[/p][p]🔸Players can now jump directly to a Peddler’s location by using the shortcut button on the world map when they spawn.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain tutorial quests embedded in the main questline could not be progressed under certain conditions.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where monsters in certain quests in Brightwater Keep had lower-than-intended health values.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in Storm’s End where selecting certain dialogue options triggered the wrong battle.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the Peddler occasionally did not appear in Storm’s End.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️CONTROL & INPUT[/b][/h3][p]🔸After using fast travel, players will now be automatically placed on their mount.[/p][p]🔸Adjusted the location of the Mainhall Signpost in Renan’s Rest.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where ladders in certain areas occasionally could not be interacted with.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in the Historic Site in Mole’s Town where the lever could not be activated.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain objects would appear when using the Search function in Castle Black, but were not actually present in the environment.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain structures within the Seven Sunset Septry Enemy Hideout could not be moved under certain conditions. tags.feature: Our June 26 update brings the first major content drop since launch, and with it, the arrival of [b]Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b].

This new season introduces the Kraken Raid, where a powerful new enemy and valuable rewards await. The newly added Amulet system also brings fresh ways to enhance your strength and customize your build.

A new difficulty level for World Boss Drogon has also been added, offering a greater challenge for seasoned players alongside a host of new content. This update also brings limited-time seasonal events, a range of system improvements, and a round of bug fixes for known issues.
🔹Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes officially begins.
🔹A brand-new season pass is now available.
🔹The new region [b]Crow’s Nest[/b] is now available.
🔹New main quests, as well as side quests and encounter quests have been added.
🔹Exploration Progress rewards for stages 3 and 4 have been added to the Stormlands region.
🔹New items have been added to the Tribute Exchange Shop, and the exchange limits for certain items have been increased.
🔹3 new Artifacts have been added.
🔹The new co-op content [b]Kraken Raid [/b]has been added.
🔹Access the dungeon through the [b]Weirwood located within Storm’s End[/b], in the Stormlands.
🔹A new leaderboard for Kraken Raid rankings has been added.
🔹New achievements related to the Kraken Raid have been added.
🔹Visit the [b]Amulet Workshop [/b](accessible via Raven Messenger > Amulet Workshop or the actual Amulet Workshop in Renan’s Rest) to craft and polish Amulets.
🔹A total of 9 Amulets have been added (3 Rare, 3 Epic, and 3 Legendary).
🔹All Amulets provide fixed effects, along with additional random effects based on their rarity.
🔹Wormwalks has been expanded from stage 40 to 50.
🔹A new difficulty tier for World Boss Drogon is now available. This version of Drogon can be accessed from the [b]Scorched Plain [/b]in the Stormlands region.
🔹New emojis and emotes have been added.
🔸The maximum character level has been increased to [b]level 50[/b].
🔸Set Research levels have been expanded to [b]level 50[/b].
🔸Two new Equipment Sets and Set Effects have been added: [b]Guardian [/b]and [b]Tempest[/b].
🔸Level requirements for crafting Tier 3 to 5 equipment have been eased.
🔸Using Ruin Runners or Relic Finders for Artifact Expeditions no longer consumes worker stamina.
🔸The Momentum penalty for fighting enemies with higher Momentum has been removed.
🔸Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Altar of Memories will no longer require RP to obtain rewards. Instead, rewards are now granted by using up the reward attempts for each activity.

🔸With this new reward system, reward counts will be automatically consumed and rewards will be granted upon clearing the content. As a result, the unclaimed dungeon reward system will no longer apply.
🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.
🔸A new Battle Pass and Season Pass have been added.

notes.title: Developer Note: What’s Next for Kingsroad
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif[/img]

[b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/b]

We want to extend our sincerest gratitude to everyone who has joined us on this long journey—from our initial Early Access launch all the way to our official release.

Since launch, we've been closely listening to the invaluable feedback you've shared. Our development team has been working hard not only to resolve immediate issues, but also to shape the long-term direction of our post-launch updates.

Today, we’re excited to share the first details of what’s next: [b]Season 1[/b] is on the horizon.

This will be our first major post-launch update, bringing new content, storylines, and systems that mark the beginning of an ongoing seasonal experience. We’ll have more to share soon, including a full roadmap, but today’s note includes an early preview of what to expect.

Today’s update focused primarily on addressing key stability issues and major concerns identified after launch.

Now that the update is live, we wanted to use this opportunity to share with our players where things currently stand and give everyone a sneak peek at what’s coming next as we approach our next major update.


[h2][b][Improvements and New Content][/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]1. Improved Patch Download Stability on Mobile Devices[/b][/h3]
We’ve made key improvements to address issues that were affecting patch file downloads on mobile devices. With this update, the download and installation process should now be significantly more stable and reliable. 

In addition, we’ve resolved several progression-blocking bugs that occurred during gameplay. These fixes should result in a smoother, more consistent experience for players on mobile platforms.

[h3][b]2. Character Appearance Change Feature[/b][/h3]
We’re excited to introduce a highly requested feature: the ability to change your character’s appearance.

Starting with the update on June 25th (PT), a new item—Character Appearance Change Coupon—will be added to the game. With this item, you’ll be able to freely customize both your character’s gender and appearance.

To celebrate the update, we’ll be giving all players a free Character Appearance Change Coupon—so you can jump back in and reimagine your character any way you like.

[h3][b]3. New Raid Content[/b][/h3]
Prepare for our first major content update: the [b]Kraken Raid[/b].

This new raid will be available on a weekly basis and won’t consume RP to participate. It’s designed to be a challenging new experience for players at all levels—and we can’t wait to see how you rise to the occasion.

[h2][b][Updates][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/fabb4add42193f68b42051f35f1e342aa3f72983.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Season 1: The Iron Islands and the Kraken[/b][/h3]
Our first major content update introduces a brand-new seasonal experience: [b]Season 1 – The Iron Islands and the Kraken[/b].

Brace yourselves! [b]Season 1: ‘The Iron Islands and the Kraken’[/b] is just around the corner, plunging you into the heart of an invasion sweeping in from across the sea. Get ready to forge a new saga with thrilling storylines and gameplay features designed to elevate your entire Westeros experience!

We’ll be introducing our new seasonal content across two developer notes.
In today’s update, we’re giving you an early look at the season’s story setup and the upcoming Kraken Raid.

[i][b]“The Salt Throne shall tremble.”[/b][/i]

Following a revelation from the Drowned Priests, many Ironborn have begun their advance towards the North. In the name of the Drowned God, they depart their isles, launching an invasion armed with the power of the sea and their indomitable iron will.

This season plunges you into the chaos unleashed from the Iron Islands, the North's desperate struggle to resist, and your own saga unfolding at the epicenter of the conflict.

[h3][b]2. The Kraken Raid: Challenge the Depths[/b][/h3]
In a previous dev note, we promised to introduce content that wouldn’t require RP to participate—and now it’s almost here.

Our first large-scale raid, [b]The Kraken Raid[/b], is set to make its debut.

[previewyoutube=i8LvJhVhN8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Gather your allies! Journey through the Stormlands’ Altar of Memories to access the new raid dungeon.

A true terror has surfaced: off the coast of a remote Iron Islands isle, [b]a colossal Kraken[/b] has emerged from the ocean's abyss. This formidable beast poses a significant threat.

You'll need to team up with other skilled players to confront this massive creature. This new raid encounter is designed to test your group with:
[list]
[*] Unique environmental interactions.
[*] Challenging boss mechanics to decipher and overcome.
[*] Intense cooperative combat where smart strategies and tight teamwork are crucial for victory.
[/list]Face this challenging encounter weekly, with no RP cost to participate. Assemble your team and prepare to battle the Kraken!


[h2][b][Additional Information][/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]1. Compensation for Artifact Expedition Adjustments[/b][/h3]
We’d like to take a moment to address the recent changes made to the Artifact Expedition system.

We’ve heard feedback from many of our Early Access players regarding concerns around fairness following the system update. Please know that your passion and dedication throughout the Early Access period have not gone unnoticed—and we remain deeply grateful for your support.

To ensure fairness under the newly adjusted system introduced after launch, we’ll be reviewing the total number of Artifact Cart items used during Early Access and provide compensation calibrated to what would have realistically been obtainable under the improved system.

This will require the development of new tracking and support features, so we ask for your patience as we work through this process. We’re aiming to have everything ready by June 12th, at which point we’ll follow up with more information outlining the eligibility criteria, compensation details, and distribution timeline.


[h3][b]2. Further Notice Regarding Recovery of Founder’s Packs[/b][/h3]
We’d also like to share an update on the unintended distribution of Founder’s Packs to accounts that had not purchased them. Although the initial recovery process has been completed, we’ve received considerable feedback concerning the absence of clear information regarding players who had already claimed the packs.

We are currently preparing an additional recovery operation for remaining accounts, and have been developing and testing new tools to ensure accurate retrieval of the affected items.

Once testing is complete, we’ll proceed with individually tracking and recovering any remaining misdelivered items. We’ll provide a follow-up notice once this process has been finalized.


That concludes today’s developer note.

We have a lot more to share about the next major update—so much, in fact, that we’ve split it across multiple notes. We’ll return soon with Part 2, where we’ll dive deeper into our upcoming seasonal content and more.

There are plenty of exciting reveals still to come. As mentioned in our last developer note, we’re also preparing a full update [b]roadmap[/b]—stay tuned!

Our team carefully reviews every piece of feedback shared across all our communities. We’re committed to delivering meaningful improvements and doing everything we can to make your experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] as enjoyable as possible. While some changes may take time, we’ll continue pushing forward—and we appreciate your patience and continued support.

Sincerely,
[b]JANG[/b]
Executive Producer, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad

notes.title: 6/3 Update Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Thank you for joining us on this epic journey with the official launch of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]. As we settle into this new era, our team is committed to ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for everyone.

This patch focuses on resolving a number of known issues and includes some quality-of-life improvements.

You can find the full list of changes below.

[b]1️⃣ [New Events]
2️⃣ [Adjustments & Bug Fixes] [/b]


[h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536604072953774199][Go to Events][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/536602812925083836?snr=2___][New Trial Race & Bonus Time Events][/url]


[h2][b]🛠️ ADJUSTMENTS & BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3]
🔸Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.

[h3][b]⚖️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
The Assassin class skill [Agile Movement] was previously causing an unintended large reduction to the enemy’s Daze gauge in a single hit. This issue has now been fixed with an appropriate adjustment to the skill.

🔸The Daze damage dealt by the enhanced evasion attack after using the Assassin’s [Agile Movement] skill has been adjusted.
🔸The Hitstun effect applied to enemies by the Assassin’s enhanced evasion attack after using [Agile Movement] has been removed.

[h3][b]⚔️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where the associated Momentum did not increase accordingly when leveling up certain skills past a certain threshold.
🔸Fixed an issue where players were unable to move during the main quest [Travel to Last Hearth].
🔸Fixed an issue where using the escape function in Last Hearth’s Multi Space area caused characters to become stuck in terrain.
🔸Fixed an issue where attempting to create an Alliance with an already existing name would display a [Logic Error] message.
🔸Fixed an issue where resetting the Trait Tree under certain conditions could cause associated Skill Points to be lost.
▸ Lost Skill Points due to this issue will be sequentially returned after June 4, 01:00 AM (PT).
🔸Fixed an issue where RP would occasionally not recharge after logging out of the game for a period of time.
🔸Fixed an issue where Trading Routes for certain regions occasionally did not unlock despite meeting all conditions.
🔸Rewards obtained from defeating wildlife near the [Secluded Hut] Bandit Camp in the Stormlands have been changed.
🔸Fixed an issue where the Attack Speed Increase stat was not being applied properly.
🔸Fixed an issue where the Red Cockatrice’s attacks in the Altar of Memories dungeon did not apply the intended Attack Speed Decrease effect.
🔸Fixed an issue during Beyond the Wall Expedition where the Attack Speed Decrease effect based on the Cold Gauge was not applied.
🔸Fixed an issue in [Explore cliff paths] in Beyond the Wall Expedition where the tree could not be cut down, preventing progress.
🔸Fixed an issue in which [Bandit Camp in the Gift] could not be cleared under certain conditions.
🔸Adjusted the push notification frequency for Production, Trade, and Relic Expedition activities.
🔸Fixed an issue where the weekly mission [Defeat World Bosses] could not be cleared properly.
🔸Fixed an issue where the quest information was not displayed properly when reconnecting to the game in the World Boss Drogon area.
🔸Fixed a visual issue where the Boar Territory Signpost was not displayed in the Storm’s End Exploration Progress.
🔸Fixed an issue where players could not receive rewards upon clearing Wormwalks with a full inventory.

[h3][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h3]
🔸New items have been added to the shop.
🔸Fixed an issue where tapping on the Joffrey’s Outfit in the Suggested tab did not bring up the purchase pop-up.

[h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where the stats for Elite enemies encountered during the side quest [Blood in the Water] in Storm’s End were incorrectly low.
🔸Fixed an issue preventing players from leaving the quest area during the main quest [Forbidden Knowledge].
🔸Fixed an issue where the Peddler would occasionally fail to appear in the Stormlands.
🔸Fixed an issue where the chest could not be interacted with during the Stormlands side quest [Nowhere to Return To].
🔸Fixed an issue where progress could be occasionally blocked during the main quest [Allies of the North].
🔸Fixed an issue where there was a delay in door interactions during the side quest [The Men of Kings and Queens].
🔸Fixed an issue where Elite Enemy kills were not being properly counted in certain Enemy Hideouts.
🔸Fixed an issue where players could occasionally get stuck in terrain, preventing them from moving during the main quest [Red Priest].
🔸Fixed an issue during the side quest [The Attack on Knifesbend] where a black screen would appear at the start of combat.
🔸Fixed an issue where the “Mount” icon would persistently be displayed under certain conditions during the main quest [Allies of the North].
🔸Fixed an issue where some servant NPCs had delayed movement during the main quest [Infiltrating the Keep].
🔸Fixed an issue where some dialogue was not displayed properly in certain side quests in the Stormlands.
🔸Fixed an issue where tutorial cutscenes would occasionally not play, preventing game progression.

[h3][b]📌 UI/UX & VISUAL[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where certain enemy attack animations were not playing appropriately for the situation.
🔸Added an option to lower lighting effect quality in the graphics settings.
🔸Fixed an issue where some in-game text was displayed in an unintended language.
🔸Fixed an issue where the ranged attack cancel button was not visible on iOS devices.
🔸Fixed an issue where the effect for the [Violent Charge] skill was displayed even if no enemies were hit.
🔸Fixed an issue where the quantity of rewards acquired from defeating a Ferocious Beast was displayed incorrectly when receiving 2x rewards while the inventory was full.
▸ Please note that while the displayed number was incorrect, the correct amount of rewards was properly granted.
🔸Fixed an issue where the teleportation barrier would not appear during zone transitions in certain situations.
🔸Fixed an issue in Altar of Memories: Unicorn where the hands of players holding a lance were positioned awkwardly.
🔸Fixed an issue in Beyond the Wall Expedition where footprints were incorrectly placed during the blizzard stage.
🔸Fixed some awkward visual effects during the Ferocious Beast - Giant Bear encounter.
🔸Improved visibility on certain skill effects used by the Ferocious Beast - Infected Boar.
🔸Fixed an issue where certain tutorial overview entries were not displayed.
🔸Fixed an issue where Portuguese language settings would revert to an unintended language.
▸ Please note that this issue can now be fixed by downloading the new version of the game through your platform of choice after the update.
🔸Fixed an issue where owned equipment was not refreshed when entering the [Change Random Equipment Effects] menu after reforging a piece of equipment.
🔸The Emergency Escape button image has been changed for improved visibility.
🔸The images of [Intact/Good-quality Pelts] acquired upon defeating Ferocious Beasts have been changed for improved visibility.

 
We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: Notice Regarding Retrieval of Founder's Packs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

First and foremost, we want to extend our sincerest gratitude to everyone who’s joined us for the official launch of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]. We’re incredibly grateful for your support and excitement as we begin this new journey together.

As part of our ongoing efforts to ensure a smooth experience, we want to address an issue that recently came to our attention. It appears that a number of players who did not purchase the Founder's Pack DLC may have noticed it appearing in their in-game mailbox. We understand this might have caused a bit of confusion, especially since the items weren’t actually claimable.

If you happened to be one of the players who saw the Founder's Pack in your mailbox, please note that we will be removing the Founder's Packs in question from your mailbox soon. 

We apologize for any confusion or inconvenience this may have caused, and thank you for your understanding. Please see the details below:

[h3][b]☑️ Who this applies to: [/b][/h3]
🔹Accounts that received Founder's Packs in their mailbox without a purchase.

[h3][b]☑️ Reclamation Period: 
[/b][/h3]🔹All packs will be removed sequentially starting May 22, 12:45 AM (PT)

[h3][b]❗ Additional Notes
[/b][/h3]🔹The items in question will be automatically reclaimed from your mailbox. During this brief process, you may possibly be disconnected from the game. 

We understand that even minor hiccups can impact your gaming experience, and for that, we genuinely apologize. Please know that we are dedicated to constantly improving and delivering the best possible service for all our players.

Thank you once again for your understanding and continued support. We truly appreciate you being a part of the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] community!

notes.title: Get Rewards with Twitch Drops!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies.
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

The world of Westeros is opening its gates—and we’re kicking things off with a live Official Launch Showcase on Twitch!

[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/591771368562885896]📺 [Join us for the Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Official Launch Show!][/url][/b]

And that’s not all—Twitch Drops will be enabled throughout the event, giving you the chance to earn exclusive in-game rewards just by watching. Whether you’re already on your journey or just getting started, don’t miss this chance to stock up on useful items and celebrate the launch together with the community!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b]☑️ What Are Twitch Drops?[/b][/h3]
Twitch Drops are a special feature that rewards viewers with various in-game items for [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] based on their broadcast watch time. 

[h3][b]☑️ Twitch Drops Event Period[/b][/h3]
May 17, 05:00 PM - June 17, 05:00 PM (PT)

[h3][b]☑️ Twitch Drops Watch Rewards[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/d98a782486e9e06202e02fd6f1362968912e91c6.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]☑️ How to Claim Twitch Drops Rewards[/b][/h3]

[b]1️⃣ Watch an Eligible Stream[/b]
🔹 Head to the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] category on Twitch and look for streamers with Drops enabled.
⚠️ [b]Important[/b]: You can only earn rewards if you are watching while logged into your Twitch account that is linked to your [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] account.

[b]2️⃣ Claim via Twitch Inventory[/b]
🔹 Click your profile icon on the top-right corner of the Twitch page.
🔹 Go to Drops & Rewards > Inventory, then click Claim on the reward.
🔹Go to the [b][u][url=https://gameofthrones.netmarble.com/drops]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Twitch Drops Page[/url][/u][/b] and select [Claim Reward]. The rewards will then be sent to your in-game mailbox. 

[h3][b] 📢 Additional Notes[/b][/h3]
🔹 To participate in Twitch Drops, your Netmarble ID account must be linked to your Twitch account. 
🔹 Once you claim your first reward, you cannot switch to another account. 
🔹Your Netmarble ID and Twitch accounts will remain linked throughout the Twitch Drops event period and will automatically be unlinked after the event concludes. 
🔹Twitch Drops viewing rewards are limited to once per account during the event period based on watch time, and will be delivered to your in-game mailbox. 
🔹Twitch Drops viewing rewards have an expiration date. It is highly recommended that you claim your rewards from your Twitch Inventory before they expire, and then claim them from the Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Twitch Drops Page within 30 days of claiming them in your Twitch Inventory, otherwise they will be deleted. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tune in to watch a range of streamers take on the world of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] and unlock exclusive in-game rewards through Twitch Drops. Whether you're here for the gameplay, the personalities, or the prizes—there’s something waiting for you.

Thank you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]
